title: ASICS GEL-Kayano 25 - Womens Running Shoes Aquarium/Black 1012A026400 Size 7
text: For 25 years, the ASICS GEL-Kayano has delivered the perfect combination of cushioning and support. Made for runners who overpronate, the GEL-Kayano 25 uses GEL Cushioning to absorb shock and FlyteFoam Lyte cushioning to return energy with every step. The result is a smooth stride that always feels fast and responsive. An Internal Fit System works together with an updated heel counter to hold your foot securely in place, creating a strong, stable running platform you can depend on mile after mile. Jacquard mesh upper combines multidirectional stretch and lightweight reinforcement for a snug fit that moves with you as you run. Internal Fit System delivers supportive lockdown over the footbed for a secure fit that never limits your range of motion. Meta Clutch exoskeletal heel counter holds your foot firmly in place, eliminating wiggle room for injury. FlyteFoam Lyte midsole for lightweight, responsive cushioning that returns energy with every step. Rear and forefoot GEL Cushioning Systems cushion and absorb shock, encouraging a smoother stride. Guidance Trusstic System works together with Guidance Line's deep vertical flex groove to stabilize your stride and allow a more natural transition from heelstrike to toe-off. ASICS High Abrasion Rubber in high-wear areas of the outsole for dependable traction without extra weight.

title: HOKA Men's Speedgoat 2 Trail Running Shoes in Caribbean Sea/Blue Depths, Size 8.5
text: Inspired by Karl Meltzer, who holds the record for most 100-mile trail race wins, and epitomizes the "go everywhere, run everything" attitude, this shoe is designed to attack all breeds of technical trail. The wide midsole creates a stable platform for the foot and offers a wide toe box with reinforced areas where your feet need them. The outsole features deep, aggressive Vibram® lugs which hold up to all kinds of rugged terrain, while the more forgiving upper offers comfort up top. The Speedgoat 2 means business. This is one fast, tough trail running shoe.

title: HOKA Women's Tivra Road Running Shoes in White/Nimbus Cloud, Size 6
text: The Tivra is designed to support your most intense and dynamic training. It has a unique forefoot design that improves balance and helps support the foot for 360-degree movement. Using rubberized foam, the Tivra ensures immediate responsiveness and cushion when and where you need it. And this confident feel carries through with straps on either side of the upper to offer support and security. The Tivra is definitely a mold-breaker.
